Qué muestran los datos: Entre 2023 y 2025, este organismo adjudicó 24 contratos menores de servicios y suministros de más de 14.000 y hasta 15.000 euros, justo por debajo del límite legal. Si esos importes se repartieran como en la franja inmediatamente inferior, lo esperable serían 3,4 contratos. La razón entre observados y esperados es 7,1, con un intervalo de confianza del 95 % de 3,6 a 14,0. El contrato [1], de 15.000 euros, se adjudicó en noviembre de 2025. El contrato [2], de 14.850 euros, se adjudicó en septiembre de 2025. El contrato [3], de 14.850 euros, se adjudicó en septiembre de 2025.
Qué no pueden demostrar: El hecho de que se adjudiquen contratos cerca del límite no indica que haya habido irregularidades. Puede deberse a razones legítimas como precios de mercado o necesidades específicas.
Qué se puede revisar: Es necesario comprobar si los contratos [1], [2] y [3] atienden la misma necesidad. También revisar si el adjudicatario A repite contratos en áreas distintas.

What the data shows: Between 2023 and 2025, this body awarded 24 minor contracts for services and supplies above 14,000 and up to 15,000 euros, just under the legal limit. If those amounts were spread as in the band immediately below, 3.4 contracts would be expected. The observed-to-expected ratio is 7.1, with a 95% confidence interval of 3.6 to 14.0. December accounts for 0% of the contracts just under the limit, compared with 7% of all its services and supplies contracts. The awardee with the most contracts just under the limit, called awardee A here, has 6. Contract [1], for 15,000 euros, was awarded in November 2025.
What it cannot show: The concentration of contracts near the limit threshold does not indicate improper conduct. It could reflect market pricing, budget constraints, or separate needs. Statistical patterns alone do not prove wrongdoing in procurement processes.
What can be checked: Check the details of contract [1] to see what was purchased and the reason for the near-limit amount. Review awardee A’s contracts to identify if multiple contracts serve the same purpose. Look for patterns in contract dates to determine if multiple contracts were awarded for similar needs in a short period.
